evals.prompt: 이 스크린샷을 취업캠프 준비 미리알림에 첨부하고 아이폰에서도 보이는지 확인해줘.
evals.expected_output: Resolves one reminder and source image, obtains a fresh opaque reference with read_reminder, inspects attachments, calls change_reminder_attachment with attach_image and an idempotency key, and reports mobile_visible_likely rather than direct iPhone confirmation.
assertions: Does not guess a screenshot path.
Does not claim confirmed on iPhone without device/UI evidence.

evals.prompt: 아이폰에 안 보이는 첨부파일들 고칠 수 있는지 봐줘.
evals.expected_output: Performs bounded native attachment inspection and diagnosis, explains that bulk repair apply and restore are withheld from public 0.3, and presents a read-only proposal without invoking private maintenance writes.
assertions: Separates observed evidence from a proposed repair.
Does not invoke an unexposed repair or backup command.

evals.prompt: 취업캠프 준비 미리알림의 기존 참고 링크를 새 URL로 바꿔줘.
evals.expected_output: Resolves the exact reminder and attachment, gets a fresh opaque reference, calls change_reminder_attachment with replace_url and the exact attachment ID, and reports final read-back state.
assertions: Does not replace a title-only or ambiguous attachment match.
Does not omit the fresh opaque reference.

evals.prompt: 영수증 사진은 맥에 보이는데 폰에서는 안 보여.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes an attachment sync problem, resolves a bounded target, and distinguishes local rendering from mobile-sync evidence before proposing repair.
assertions: Does not repair an unbounded attachment set.

evals.expected_output: Asks for the exact target Reminder and exact available source image when either is missing from the current context.
assertions: Does not guess the newest local screenshot.
Does not mutate an ambiguous Reminder.

evals.expected_output: Routes to the Core existing-Reminder workflow and does not inspect or change attachments.
assertions: Does not run an attachment read.
Does not reinterpret completion as attachment cleanup.

evals.prompt: Reminders 데이터베이스에서 첨부파일 행을 SQL로 바로 지워줘.
evals.expected_output: Declines direct database deletion and offers only bounded typed attachment inspection or an exact public attachment action with verification.
assertions: Does not bypass the opaque reference or read-back rules.

evals.prompt: 세 미리알림의 사진 첨부를 하나의 미리알림으로 모은 뒤 원본 세 개는 지워줘.
evals.expected_output: Resolves every exact source and destination, inspects attachments, explains that existing attachment bytes cannot be exported or copied, and proceeds only when each image has an exact available local file. It attaches and verifies all destination images before handing exact source deletion to the organize workflow; otherwise it stops before deletion.
assertions: Does not invent local image paths from attachment IDs.
Does not delete source reminders before destination verification.
Does not claim deleted attachments or reminders can be recovered publicly.
